entry.title: The Distinguished Gentleman’s Drive
entry.content:
An on-road motoring fundraising event, uniting classic cars built 40 years or older, encouraging drivers and passengers around the world to dress dapper and drive for men’s health.

Always fortunate with the weather over at @marquecollective_ , this time for the #DGD2026. I hope everyone had a lovely cruise, I wish I could’ve tagged along for more photos!
